purpose: Within a fixed OLD/NEW interpolation and module-neighborhood family, first enforce absolute cross-time robustness gates, then jointly maximize account CAGR and annualized excess over the Shanghai Composite price index.
candidate_construction: Exactly 13 specifications fixed before results: both endpoints; full linear interpolation at alpha 0.25/0.50/0.75; and OLD-based one-module bridges for each of M,T,H,outer at alpha 0.25/0.50. Weight formula is (1-alpha)*OLD + alpha*NEW within named blocks. No result-contingent additions, deletions, or altered weights.

execution.fees_and_slippage: unchanged from the frozen Batch004/006/008 engine

shared_q1_random_starts.sampling: For each year 2020 through 2024, sample without replacement from sorted January-March execution sessions and share the exact starts across all candidates.
shared_q1_random_starts.last_signal_date: calendar year end minus 37 calendar days

hard_robustness_gates.annual: Every 2020-2024 full-window account return must be >0; every year must contain at least 180 generated signals and at least 150 completed trades; worst annual excess must be >= -0.10; mean annual excess must be >0.
hard_robustness_gates.leave_one_year_out: For each of five omitted-year folds, the geometric mean of the remaining four annual strategy returns must be >0 and its difference from the geometric mean Shanghai Composite return must be >0.
hard_robustness_gates.expanding_time: For 2020-2022, 2020-2023, and 2020-2024 prefixes, strategy geometric CAGR and its difference from benchmark geometric CAGR must both be >0.
hard_robustness_gates.shared_q1_random_starts: All 25 runs must end with no positions or pending orders; each run must complete >=120 trades; the minimum of the five per-year mean returns must be >0; at least 80% of all runs must have positive return.
hard_robustness_gates.parameter_neighborhood: Predefined path-adjacent candidates are the neighborhood. The candidate and every listed neighbor must independently pass annual, leave-one-year-out, expanding-time, and Q1-start gates; neighborhood minimum full-window CAGR and annualized excess must both be >0.
hard_robustness_gates.audit: The frozen champion must pass raw unadjusted OHLC, complete corporate-action and delisting coverage, all annual signal/trade minima, and empty terminal state. Audit failure ends the batch without reselection.

return_definitions.benchmark_cagr: (Shanghai Composite 2024 last close / 2019 last close)^(1/5)-1, price index without dividends.
return_definitions.annual_excess: calendar-year strategy account return minus the same calendar-year Shanghai Composite price-index return. Report arithmetic mean and minimum.

selection_rule.joint_score: Among hard-gate passers only, 0.5*percentile_rank(strategy_cagr)+0.5*percentile_rank(annualized_excess), higher is better. Because every candidate shares the same benchmark interval, these two ranks are mathematically identical; both are retained to make the dual objective explicit.

audit.raw_input: original unadjusted OHLC through 2024-12-31 plus complete pre-2025 corporate actions and delistings
